• Conoscenze tecniche proprie in tutto lo stack e l'infrastruttura, mantenendo il contesto architettonico, fornendo guida su moderni standard web, API design e modelli orientati agli eventi.

• Sii pratico scrivendo e possedendo il codice di qualità della produzione, dalle API GraphQL e dai consumatori in streaming ai front-end interattivi. Impostare un alto bar attraverso recensioni di PR riflessivo e migliorare continuamente l'affidabilità e l'operabilità.

• Agire come mentore tecnico per gli ingegneri sullo sviluppo full-stack, i principi di cloud-native e le migliori pratiche per interagire con le piattaforme di streaming dati come Kafka.

• Influenza la direzione tecnica dell'innovazione del prodotto collaborando con la leadership senior, aiutando a stabilire architetture cloud ben progettate e ben documentate e portando nuovi concetti dal prototipo alla produzione.

La tua storia

• 5+ anni di esperienza di costruzione e funzionamento applicazioni su larga scala, cloud-native in produzione.

• Ampia esperienza pratica con TypeScript, Node.js e React in un ambiente di produzione, costruendo sia sistemi back-end robusti che front-end reattivi e interattivi.

• Ampia esperienza pratica con i sistemi di database (ad esempio PostgreSQL).

• Provata esperienza di lavoro con piattaforme cloud (GCP, AWS) e una forte comprensione dei principi di infrastruttura-as-code.

• Esperienza pratica con Apache Kafka in produzione, tra cui consumare e interagire con i flussi di eventi.

• Sperimenta iniziative tecniche complesse, collaborando con più stakeholder e team e fornendo indicazioni tecniche ad altri.

• Esperienza di mentoring e coaching ingegneri, fornendo indicazioni e feedback per sostenere la loro crescita e lo sviluppo.

Bello da avere:

• Esperienza costruzione data pipelines .

• Una profonda comprensione della manipolazione degli asset 3D sul web (ad esempio, Three.js, rhino3dm).

• Esperienza precedente nello sviluppo di C# .NET
descriptionByLocale.en:
At On, everything we do is deeply rooted in innovation at its core and more specifically when it comes to our physical products. That’s why we are looking for a Staff Software Engineer for the Product Innovation team in the Product R&D Cluster with a strong background in full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, and event-driven systems to help build the next generation of digital platforms that power Product Innovation at On.

As a key member of our innovation team, you will play a pivotal role in leading the development of pioneering digital experiences that connect with our core data platform, disruptive technologies such as LightSpray and future exploratory innovations. You will be responsible for designing and building scalable, cloud-native applications from the ground up. In addition to being hands-on, you will mentor team members, share your knowledge and expertise, and influence the technical direction of our innovation efforts.

You will be based in Zurich and are willing to be in the office two days per week . You will collaborate closely with a cross-functional team between Tech and Innovation, while serving as the go-to person for the architectural vision of this space within the broader Technology and Product Management teams across On’s global office locations.

Your Mission

• Drive the development of cutting-edge platforms and interactive web applications, using technologies such as TypeScript, Node.js, and React , that integrate seamlessly with our core event-driven architecture (Kafka) .

• Design, build, and maintain scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure on platforms like GCP or AWS , ensuring our innovative products are built on a solid foundation.

• Own technical knowledge across the full stack and infrastructure, retaining architectural context while providing guidance on modern web standards, API design, and event-driven patterns.

• Be hands-on by writing and owning production-quality code, from GraphQL APIs and streaming consumers to interactive front-ends. Setting a high bar through thoughtful PR reviews and continuously improving reliability and operability.

• Act as a technical mentor to engineers on full-stack development, cloud-native principles, and best practices for interacting with streaming data platforms like Kafka.

• Influence the technical direction of product innovation by collaborating with senior leadership, helping to establish well-designed and well-documented cloud architectures , and bringing new concepts from prototype to production.

Your Story

• 5+ years of experience building and operating large-scale, cloud-native applications in production.

• Extensive hands-on experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and React in a production environment, building both robust back-end systems and responsive, interactive front-ends.

• Extensive hands-on experience with database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL).

• Proven experience working with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) and a strong understanding of infrastructure-as-code principles.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka in production, including consuming from and interacting with event streams.

• Experience leading complex technical initiatives, partnering with multiple stakeholders and teams, and providing technical direction to others.

• Experience mentoring and coaching engineers, providing guidance and feedback to support their growth and development.

Nice to haves:

• Experience building data pipelines .

• A deep understanding of 3D asset manipulation on the web (e.g., Three.js, rhino3dm).

• Previous experience in C# .NET development

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

In breve:

In questo ruolo, stai assicurando il cuore del nostro business commerciale non salta mai un colpo. Con un focus primario sul nostro ambiente di vendita al dettaglio, si agisce come il collegamento vitale tra i nostri negozi fisici e la nostra infrastruttura digitale. Capisci che in alta quota di vendita al dettaglio, la disponibilità di pagamento è il fondamento della customer experience: nessun pagamento, nessuna vendita.

La tua missione

- Controllo del ciclo di vita e del regolamento dei pagamenti: monitora il flusso end-to-end delle transazioni dall'hardware POS al conto bancario mercantile. Lei garantirà che i cicli di elaborazione siano completati con precisione.

- Platform Administration & User Management: Serve come amministratore principale per i nostri gateway di pagamento e portali di elaborazione. Ciò include la gestione di hierarchie utente complesse, l'assegnazione di permessi basati su ruoli, e garantire un accesso sicuro sia per il personale al dettaglio che per gli utenti di finanza aziendale.

- Manutenzione account & Merchant: Possiedete l'impostazione operativa e la manutenzione di ID Merchant e Terminal. Gestirete il ciclo di vita di questi account, assicurandovi che le nuove posizioni al dettaglio siano a bordo correttamente e che le configurazioni esistenti siano ottimizzate per l'efficienza di elaborazione.

- Retail Tech & Finance - Il processo di ristrutturazione: il ponte operativo tra Retail Tech (che gestisce hardware) e Finance (che gestisce la riconciliazione), che garantisce la configurazione tecnica del nostro stack di pagamento, fornisce i dati netti e granulari necessari per la rendicontazione finanziaria.

- Analisi e ottimizzazione dei dati: utilizzare grandi set di dati per monitorare la "salute" del nostro trattamento. Si indagherà "leakage" (transazioni fallite), identificare le cause principali per l'alta latenza nel punto di vendita, e monitorare le tasse di elaborazione per garantire l'efficienza in termini di costi.

La tua storia

- Operations & Administration Expertise: Proven experience management payment platforms, back-offices gateway, or merchant acquisiting portals. You are comfortable navigando complesse interfacce amministrative per gestire gli utenti e le impostazioni di sistema.

- Conoscenze del trattamento: una profonda comprensione della meccanica dei pagamenti, compresi i ruoli degli acquirenti, dei trasformatori e dei sistemi di carte.

- Comunicazione cross-functional: La capacità di parlare "tecnologia" con gli ingegneri hardware e "finanziare" con i contabili, assicurando che i cambiamenti operativi soddisfino le esigenze di entrambi i reparti.

- Precisione analitica: Forte capacità quantitative per l'elaborazione dei dati e l'analisi numerica. È possibile guardare i log delle transazioni grezzi o i rapporti di regolamento e individuare le correlazioni che indicano un problema di elaborazione sistemica.

- Principi di gestione aziendale: una solida comprensione dei flussi di lavoro organizzativi e della logica aziendale, in particolare per quanto riguarda il modo in cui le operazioni di pagamento supportano il più ampio P&L.

Attributi di un candidato di successo

- Process Architect: non sei soddisfatto dei workaround manuali. Sei costantemente alla ricerca di modi per standardizzare e automatizzare per rendere la "camera motore" più efficiente.

- Pensatore di sistemi: non si vede un pagamento come un evento isolato; si vede come un viaggio. È naturalmente mappare come un cambiamento nello stack Retail Tech influenzerà il flusso di dati in Finanza e altri sottosistemi.

- Resilienza operativa: si rimane calmi e metodici quando si verificano le latenze di elaborazione. Si dà priorità alla stabilità e si hanno "bias for uptime," assicurando che il pavimento al dettaglio non senta l'attrito di manutenzione back-end.

- Waldative Translator: Lei è un comunicatore esperto che può spiegare concetti tecnici complessi semplicemente.

- Data-Curious: Non aspetti che si verifichi un problema; ti immergi proattivamente nell'elaborazione dei log e dei set di dati per trovare "leakage" o inefficienze che altri potrebbero trascurare.

La tua squadra

Facciamo il nostro potere Pagamento Eccellenza con trattamento senza soluzione di continuità e prevenzione delle frodi intelligenti in tutti i canali di vendita - guidando infrastrutture a scala mobile dietro il mondo.s più premium mondiale sportswear brand

Come Specialista Senior per il Trattamento dei Pagamenti e le Operazioni, sarai tu il custode del nostro flusso di pagamento. Masterizzando il backend amministrativo e mantenendo l'integrità dei nostri conti commerciali, fornisci l'infrastruttura invivibile che permette alle nostre attività di scalare con fiducia.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In short:

In this role, you are ensuring the commercial heartbeat of our business never skips a beat. With a primary focus on our retail environment , you act as the vital link between our physical stores and our digital infrastructure. You understand that in high-stakes retail, payment availability is the foundation of the customer experience: no payments, no sales.

Your Mission:

• Payment Lifecycle & Settlement Oversight: Monitor the end-to-end flow of transactions from POS hardware through to the merchant bank account. You will ensure that processing cycles are completed accurately.

• Platform Administration & User Management: Serve as the lead administrator for our payment gateways and processing portals. This includes managing complex user hierarchies, assigning role-based permissions, and ensuring secure access for both retail staff and corporate finance users.

• Account & Merchant Maintenance: Own the operational setup and maintenance of Merchant IDs and Terminal. You will manage the lifecycle of these accounts, ensuring new retail locations are onboarded correctly and existing configurations are optimized for processing efficiency.

• Retail Tech & Finance Collaboration: Act as the operational bridge between Retail Tech (who manage hardware) and Finance (who manage reconciliation). You will ensure that the technical configuration of our payment stack provides the clean, granular data required for financial reporting.

• Data Analysis & Optimization: Utilize large datasets to monitor the "health" of our processing. You will investigate "leakage" (failed transactions), identify root causes for high latency at the point of sale, and monitor processing fees to ensure cost-efficiency.

Your Story:

• Operations & Administration Expertise: Proven experience managing payment platforms, gateway back-offices, or merchant acquiring portals. You are comfortable navigating complex administrative interfaces to manage users and system settings.

• Processing Knowledge: A deep understanding of the mechanics of payments, including the roles of acquirers, processors, and card schemes.

• Cross-Functional Communication: The ability to speak "tech" with hardware engineers and "finance" with accountants, ensuring that operational changes satisfy the requirements of both departments.

• Analytical Precision: Strong quantitative capabilities for data processing and numerical analysis. You can look at raw transaction logs or settlement reports and spot the correlations that indicate a systemic processing issue.

• Business Management Principles: A solid grasp of organizational workflows and business logic, specifically regarding how payment operations support the broader P&L.

Attributes of a succesful candidate

• Process Architect: You aren't satisfied with manual workarounds. You are constantly looking for ways to standardize and automate to make the "engine room" run more efficiently.

• Systems Thinker: You don't see a payment as an isolated event; you see it as a journey. You naturally map out how a change in the Retail Tech stack will affect the data flow into Finance and other subsystems.

• Operational Resilience: You remain calm and methodical when processing latencies occur. You prioritize stability and have a "bias for uptime", ensuring the retail floor never feels the friction of back-end maintenance.

• Collaborative Translator: You are a skilled communicator who can explain complex technical concepts simply.

• Data-Curious: You don't wait for a problem to arise; you proactively dive into processing logs and datasets to find "leakage" or inefficiencies that others might overlook.

Your Team:

We power Payment Excellence with seamless processing and smart fraud prevention across all sales channels - driving scalable infrastructure behind the world’s most premium global sportswear brand

descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Kurz gesagt:

In dieser Funktion sorgen Sie dafür, dass der kommerzielle Herzschlag unseres Geschäfts nie überspringt. Mit einem primären Fokus auf unser Retail-Umfeld fungieren Sie als die entscheidende Verbindung zwischen unseren physischen Geschäften und unserer digitalen Infrastruktur. Sie verstehen, dass im High-Stakes-Handel die Zahlungsverfügbarkeit die Grundlage des Kundenerlebnisses ist: keine Zahlungen, keine Verkäufe.

Ihre Mission

- Payment Lifecycle & Settlement Oversight: Überwachen Sie den End-to-End-Fluss von Transaktionen von POS-Hardware bis zum Handelsbankkonto. Sie stellen sicher, dass die Verarbeitungszyklen genau abgeschlossen sind.

- Plattformverwaltung & Benutzerverwaltung: Als Lead Administrator für unsere Zahlungs-Gateways und Verarbeitungsportale. Dazu gehören die Verwaltung komplexer Benutzerhierarchien, die Zuweisung rollenbasierter Berechtigungen und die Gewährleistung eines sicheren Zugangs sowohl für Retail-Mitarbeiter als auch für Corporate Finance-Nutzer.

- Account & Merchant Maintenance: Besitzen Sie die betriebliche Einrichtung und Wartung von Merchant IDs und Terminals. Sie verwalten den Lebenszyklus dieser Konten, sorgen dafür, dass neue Einzelhandelsstandorte korrekt an Bord sind und bestehende Konfigurationen für die Verarbeitungseffizienz optimiert sind.

- Retail Tech & Finance Collaboration: Handeln Sie als operative Brücke zwischen Retail Tech (die Hardware verwalten) und Finance (die Versöhnung verwalten). Sie stellen sicher, dass die technische Konfiguration unseres Payment Stacks die sauberen, granularen Daten liefert, die für die Finanzberichterstattung erforderlich sind.

- Datenanalyse & Optimierung: Nutzen Sie große Datensätze, um die "Gesundheit" unserer Verarbeitung zu überwachen. Sie untersuchen "Leakage" (gefälschte Transaktionen), identifizieren Wurzelursachen für hohe Latenz am Point of Sale und überwachen die Bearbeitungsgebühren, um Kosteneffizienz zu gewährleisten.

Ihre Geschichte

- Operations & Administration Expertise: Bewährte Erfahrung beim Management von Zahlungsplattformen, Gateway Backoffices oder Händler-Erwerb-Portalen. Sie sind komfortabel im Navigieren komplexer administrativer Schnittstellen zur Verwaltung von Benutzern und Systemeinstellungen.

- Verarbeitungswissen: Ein tiefes Verständnis der Zahlungsmechanik, einschließlich der Rollen der Erwerber, Verarbeiter und Kartensysteme.

- Cross-Functional Communication: Die Fähigkeit, mit Hardware-Ingenieuren "Tech" zu sprechen und mit Buchhaltern "Finanzen" zu machen, um sicherzustellen, dass die betrieblichen Veränderungen den Anforderungen beider Abteilungen entsprechen.

- Analytische Präzision: Starke quantitative Fähigkeiten für die Datenverarbeitung und numerische Analyse. Sie können Roh-Transaktionsprotokolle oder Vergleichsberichte betrachten und die Korrelationen, die ein Systemverarbeitungsproblem anzeigen, lokalisieren.

- Business Management Principles: Ein solides Verständnis von organisatorischen Workflows und Geschäftslogik, insbesondere hinsichtlich der Unterstützung von Zahlungsoperationen für die breitere P&L.

Attribute eines erfolgreichen Kandidaten

- Process Architect: Sie sind mit manuellen Workarounds nicht zufrieden. Sie suchen ständig nach Möglichkeiten, den „Motorraum" effizienter zu standardisieren und zu automatisieren.

- System Thinker: Sie sehen keine Zahlung als isoliertes Ereignis, Sie sehen es als eine Reise. Sie zeigen natürlich, wie sich eine Veränderung im Retail Tech Stack auf den Datenfluss in die Finanzen und andere Subsysteme auswirkt.

- Operationelle Resilienz: Sie bleiben ruhig und methodisch, wenn Latenzzeiten auftreten. Sie priorisieren Stabilität und haben eine "Voreinstellungen für Betriebszeiten", so dass der Einzelhandel nie die Reibung der Back-End-Wartung fühlt.

- Kollaborativer Übersetzer: Sie sind ein erfahrener Kommunikator, der komplexe technische Konzepte einfach erklären kann.

- Data-Curious: Sie warten nicht auf ein Problem, Sie tauchen proaktiv in die Verarbeitung von Protokollen und Datensätzen, um "Lücken" oder Ineffizienzen zu finden, die andere übersehen könnten.

Ihr Team

Wir machen Payment Excellence mit nahtloser Verarbeitung und Smart-Betrugs-Prävention über alle Vertriebskanäle hinweg - die skalierbare Infrastruktur hinter der Welt, die weltweit höchste Premium-Sportbekleidungsmarke

Als Senior Spezialist für Zahlungsabwicklung & -operationen sind Sie der Hüter unseres Zahlungsflusses. Durch die Beherrschung des administrativen Backends und die Aufrechterhaltung der Integrität unserer Handelskonten stellen Sie die unsichtbare Infrastruktur zur Verfügung, die es unserem Unternehmen ermöglicht, mit Vertrauen zu skalieren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

En bref:

Dans ce rôle, vous assurez le rythme commercial de notre entreprise ne saute jamais un rythme. Avec un accent principal sur notre environnement de vente au détail, vous agissez comme le lien vital entre nos magasins physiques et notre infrastructure numérique. Vous comprenez que dans les magasins de détail à haut débit, la disponibilité des paiements est la base de l'expérience client : pas de paiements, pas de ventes.

Votre mission

- Cycle de vie des paiements et surveillance des règlements : Surveillez le flux de bout en bout des transactions du matériel POS au compte bancaire marchand. Vous vous assurerez que les cycles de traitement sont terminés avec précision.

- Administration de la Plateforme et gestion des utilisateurs : servir d'administrateur principal pour nos passerelles de paiement et portails de traitement, notamment gérer les informations complexes des utilisateurs, attribuer des autorisations basées sur les rôles et assurer un accès sécurisé au personnel de détail et aux utilisateurs de financement d'entreprise.

- Entretien de compte & Merchant : Possédez la configuration opérationnelle et la maintenance des ID et Terminal de Merchant. Vous gérerez le cycle de vie de ces comptes, garantissant que les nouveaux emplacements de vente sont correctement embarqués et que les configurations existantes sont optimisées pour l'efficacité du traitement.

- Collaboration technique et financière : agir comme passerelle opérationnelle entre Retail Tech (qui gère le matériel) et Finance (qui gère le rapprochement) et veiller à ce que la configuration technique de notre pile de paiement fournisse les données propres et granulaires nécessaires pour l'établissement des rapports financiers.

- Analyse et optimisation des données : Utilisez de gros ensembles de données pour surveiller la « santé » de notre traitement. Vous étudierez les « fuites » (opérations de failed), identifierez les causes profondes de la latence élevée au point de vente et surveillerez les frais de traitement pour assurer l'efficacité économique.

Votre histoire

- Exploitation et administration Expertise : Expérience de gestion des plateformes de paiement, back-offices de passerelle ou portails d'acquisition de commerçants. Vous êtes à l'aise pour naviguer des interfaces administratives complexes pour gérer les utilisateurs et les paramètres du système.

- Connaissances en matière de traitement : Une compréhension approfondie de la mécanique des paiements, y compris les rôles des acquéreurs, des transformateurs et des systèmes de cartes.

- Communication interfonctionnelle : Capacité de parler « technologie » avec les ingénieurs du matériel et « financement » avec les comptables, en veillant à ce que les changements opérationnels répondent aux exigences des deux départements.

- Précision analytique : Fortes capacités quantitatives pour le traitement des données et l'analyse numérique. Vous pouvez regarder les journaux de transactions bruts ou les rapports de règlement et repérer les corrélations qui indiquent un problème de traitement systémique.

- Principes de gestion des activités : Une bonne compréhension des flux de travail organisationnels et de la logique opérationnelle, en particulier de la façon dont les opérations de paiement appuient la P&L.

Attributs d'un candidat retenu

- Process Architect: Vous n'êtes pas satisfait des solutions manuelles. Vous recherchez constamment des moyens de standardiser et d'automatiser pour rendre la "salle des machines" plus efficace.

- System Thinker: Vous ne voyez pas un paiement comme un événement isolé; vous le voyez comme un voyage. Vous mapez naturellement comment un changement dans la pile de Tech de détail affectera le flux de données dans les finances et autres sous-systèmes.

- Resilience opérationnelle : vous restez calme et méthodique lors du traitement des latences. Vous priorisez la stabilité et avez un "paramètre pour le temps de disponibilité", garantissant que le plancher de détail ne ressent jamais la friction de l'entretien de l'arrière-boutique.

- Traducteur collaboratif : Vous êtes un communicateur compétent qui peut expliquer simplement des concepts techniques complexes.

- Données-Curieuses : Vous n'attendez pas qu'un problème se pose ; vous plongez de façon proactive dans le traitement des journaux et des ensembles de données pour trouver des "leakage" ou des inefficacités que d'autres pourraient ignorer.

Votre équipe

Nous alimentons l'excellence en matière de paiement avec un traitement sans faille et une prévention de la fraude intelligente sur tous les canaux de vente - conduire une infrastructure évolutive derrière le monde, la plus haute marque mondiale de sportswear

En tant que spécialiste principal du traitement et des opérations des paiements, vous serez le gardien de notre flux de paiement. En maîtrisant le moteur administratif et en maintenant l'intégrité de nos comptes marchands, vous fournissez l'infrastructure invisible qui permet à notre entreprise d'évoluer en toute confiance.

Whether it's celebrating the achievements of our athletes, the passions of our communities, or the innovation behind our products – our stories captivate and inspire. The ideal candidate is an expert conceptual thinker and visual artist with a deep understanding of channel best practices and leadership experience.

You strive for creative excellence in every brief, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You enter the creative process with foresight, identifying potential issues before they arise. You have a love of craft, and immerse yourself in global subcultures. You confidently navigate the creative journey from beginning to end: from strategic foundations, moving through significant conceptual development and production, and culminating in the final rollout.

• Confidently and articulately present creative ideas based on strategy and insights.

• Uphold and evolve On's distinctive visual identity , ensuring it remains fearless and unconventional.

• Manage multiple high-priority campaigns simultaneously, making sound creative decisions independently in a fast-paced environment.

• Exemplify leadership in creative, championing the On Spirits, and actively contributing to company culture and events.

Your story

• A dynamic, experienced art director with 6+ years of experience as a creative championing big ideas on global advertising and/or marketing campaigns, brand side or at an agency.

• A passionate visual storyteller with a portfolio spanning film, digital/social, OOH , and disruptive activations.

• Deep understanding of global digital user journeys and how to leverage touchpoints to drive meaningful action.

• Experience challenging the status quo and navigating complex stakeholder environments to deliver creative and commercial results.

• Comfortable leading high-impact initiatives that significantly influence the business and brand trajectory.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Capo di Stato

Rapporti a: Direttore del CRM e della Loyalty

Visione

Il Capo di Membership svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella scala del nostro programma di appartenenza per assicurarsi che continui a sostenere la nostra strategia aziendale di overarching e guidare l'impatto a lungo termine. La Nurturing Customer Loyalty è assolutamente cruciale per raggiungere le nostre ambizioni di Long-Range Plan (LRP), rendendo questo ruolo centrale per la nostra crescita futura.

Missione chiave

La vostra missione è quella di costruire una fiorente comunità di appartenenza che guida il valore reciproco per i nostri clienti più fedeli e il nostro marchio, attraverso la fornitura di un programma di appartenenza omnicanale premium che ha l'obiettivo finale di aumentare la frequenza di acquisto e CLV. Costruirete e scalate una gratificante suite di benefici che coinvolge profondamente la nostra comunità e guida gli obiettivi aziendali a lungo termine.

La tua missione

- Champion Membership at On: Servire come voce interna del membro e il portavoce del programma di appartenenza, assicurando che la fidelizzazione del cliente rimane un focus centrale sulle funzioni aziendali.
- Possedere la suite Benefits: Creare, gestire e guidare il calendario annuale delle attivazioni e dei benefici dei membri, assicurando che ci siano sempre vantaggi rilevanti e gratificanti che si adattano veramente alla nostra mission del marchio e diano valore ai nostri membri.
- Leadership strategica: consegnare e iterare sulla strategia di appartenenza overarching utilizzando un approccio di test e imparare a garantire che agisce come un driver chiave per il nostro Piano Long-Range (LRP) e obiettivi aziendali a lungo termine.
- Drive Scale & Operational Excellence: supervisionare le operazioni quotidiane del programma di appartenenza, assicurandoci di offrire esperienze omnicanale premium che portano il massimo valore alla nostra comunità e business.
- Personalizzazione & Customer Understanding: iniziative di personalizzazione del campione in tutta l'esperienza di adesione. Leva i dati e le informazioni per guidare una comprensione profonda e sfumata dei nostri clienti, permettendoci di personalizzare le interazioni e anticipare le loro esigenze.
- Collaborazione interfunzionale: Come principale stakeholder del Digital Loyalty Stream, collaborare strettamente per identificare e fornire le esperienze che portano il programma di adesione alla vita attraverso i canali. La collaborazione interfunzionale di Spearhead nel resto del business per fornire i risultati della strategia e del drive, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team di Digital, Commercial, Product, Retail, Events e Marketing.

La tua storia

- Esperienza: 7+ anni di esperienza progressiva nella pianificazione strategica, nel marketing o in un campo correlato, con un focus dimostrato sulle strategie orientate al cliente.
- Specializzazione: 3+ anni di esperienza dedicata costruzione, gestione o ottimizzazione di programmi di Loyalty o Membership a livello globale o su larga scala.
- Leadership: comprovata leadership del team e capacità di gestione dei cambiamenti, con la capacità di ispirare team interfunzionali e di guidare l'allineamento verso una visione condivisa.
- Customer-Obsessed: Profondamente appassionato di comprensione del comportamento dei consumatori, con uno sfondo forte nel sfruttare intuizioni per creare viaggi dei clienti altamente personalizzati.
- Strategic Thinker: Capacità di collegare le iniziative operative quotidiane alle ambizioni aziendali a lungo termine, in particolare nel contesto della pianificazione aziendale a lungo termine.

Incontra il team

Non stiamo solo gestendo un database, stiamo costruendo un movimento globale. Il team CRM e Loyalty si trova all’incrocio tra dati, cultura e comunità, servendo come ponte tra gli hub fisici di On e il nostro ecosistema digitale.

Siamo un Powerhouse collaborativo, ossessionato dal cliente, collaborando quotidianamente con Digital, Retail e Marketing per trasformare i corridori casual in fan per tutta la vita. Qui, si guida la carica, modellando un'esperienza premium che ispira la nostra comunità globale a continuare a muoversi.

Cosa offriamo

Su è un luogo che si concentra intorno alla crescita e al progresso. descriptionByLocale.en:
Head of Membership

Reports To: Director of CRM and Loyalty

Vision

At On, we believe in the power of movement and community; our membership program is the connective thread across our brand and commercial touchpoints, allowing us to identify and reward our most loyal customers, inspire them to move, and offer them the very best of On.

The Head of Membership will play a critical role in scaling our membership program to ensure it continues to support our overarching business strategy and drive long term impact. Nurturing Customer Loyalty is absolutely crucial to achieving our Long-Range Plan (LRP) ambitions, making this role central to our future growth.

Key Mission

Your mission is to build a thriving membership community that drives mutual value for our most loyal customers and our brand, through delivering a premium omnichannel membership program that has the final objective of increasing frequency of purchase and CLV. You will build and scale a rewarding benefits suite that deeply engages our community and drives the company's long-term business goals.

Your Mission

- Champion Membership at On: Serve as the internal voice of the member and the spokesperson for the membership program, ensuring that customer loyalty remains a central focus across business functions.
- Own the Benefits Suite: Create, manage and drive the yearly calendar of members' activations and benefits, ensuring that there’s always relevant and rewarding benefits that truly fit our brand mission and deliver value to our members.
- Strategic Leadership: Deliver and iterate on the overarching membership strategy utilizing a test and learn approach to ensure it acts as a key driver for our Long-Range Plan (LRP) and long-term business goals.
- Drive Scale & Operational Excellence: Oversee the daily operations of the membership program, ensuring we deliver premium omnichannel experiences that bring maximum value to our community and business.
- Personalization & Customer Understanding: Champion personalization initiatives across the membership experience. Leverage data and insights to drive a deep, nuanced understanding of our customers, allowing us to tailor interactions and anticipate their needs.
- Cross-functional Collaboration: As the key stakeholder to the Digital Loyalty Stream, collaborate closely to identify and deliver the experiences that bring the membership program to life across channels. Spearhead cross-functional collaboration across the rest of the business to deliver on the strategy and drive results, working closely with Digital, Commercial, Product, Retail, Events, and Marketing teams.

Your Story

- Experience: 7+ years of progressive experience in strategic planning, marketing, or a related field, with a demonstrated focus on customer-centric strategies.
- Specialization: 3+ years of dedicated experience building, managing, or optimizing Loyalty or Membership programs on a global or large-scale level.
- Leadership: Proven team leadership and change management skills, with the ability to inspire cross-functional teams and drive alignment towards a shared vision.
- Customer-Obsessed: Deeply passionate about understanding consumer behavior, with a strong background in leveraging insights to create highly personalized customer journeys.
- Strategic Thinker: Ability to connect daily operational initiatives to long-term business ambitions, specifically within the context of long-range corporate planning.

Meet the Team

We aren't just managing a database; we are building a global movement. The CRM and Loyalty team sits at the intersection of data, culture, and community, serving as the bridge between On’s physical running hubs and our digital ecosystem.

We are a collaborative, customer-obsessed powerhouse, partnering daily with Digital, Retail, and Marketing to turn casual runners into lifelong fans. We thrive on a "test-and-learn" mentality, treating our goals with the spirit of a high-performing sports team. Here, you'll lead the charge, shaping a premium experience that inspires our global community to keep moving.

What We Offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Leiter der Mitgliedschaft

Berichte an: Direktor für CRM und Loyalität

Vision

Bei On glauben wir an die Kraft von Bewegung und Gemeinschaft; unser Mitgliederprogramm ist der verbindende Faden über unsere Marken- und kommerziellen Touchpoints, so dass wir unsere treuesten Kunden identifizieren und belohnen, sie zum Umzug inspirieren und ihnen das Beste von On bieten können.

Der Head of Membership wird eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Skalierung unseres Mitgliedschaftsprogramms spielen, um sicherzustellen, dass es unsere übergreifende Geschäftsstrategie weiterhin unterstützt und langfristige Auswirkungen hat. Die Pflege der Kundenloyalität ist absolut entscheidend für die Erreichung unserer Long-Range-Plan-Ambitionen (LRP), wodurch diese Rolle für unser zukünftiges Wachstum von zentraler Bedeutung ist.

Schlüsselmission

Ihre Mission ist es, eine florierende Mitgliedergemeinschaft aufzubauen, die den gegenseitigen Wert für unsere treuesten Kunden und unsere Marke fördert, indem Sie ein Premium-Omnichannel-Mitgliedschaftsprogramm anbieten, das das endgültige Ziel hat, die Häufigkeit von Kauf und CLV zu erhöhen. Sie werden eine lohnende Benefit-Suite aufbauen und skalieren, die unsere Community tief einbindet und die langfristigen Geschäftsziele des Unternehmens vorantreibt.

Deine Mission

- Champion-Mitgliedschaft bei On: Dienen Sie als interne Stimme des Mitglieds und Sprecher des Mitgliedsprogramms und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Kundenbindung ein zentraler Schwerpunkt für alle Geschäftsfunktionen bleibt.
- Besitzen Sie die Benefits Suite: Erstellen, verwalten und steuern Sie den jährlichen Kalender der Aktivierungen und Vorteile der Mitglieder, um sicherzustellen, dass es immer relevante und lohnende Vorteile gibt, die wirklich zu unserer Markenmission passen und unseren Mitgliedern einen Mehrwert bieten.
- Strategische Führung: Liefern und iterieren Sie die übergreifende Mitgliederstrategie mit einem Test- und Lernansatz, um sicherzustellen, dass sie als wichtiger Treiber für unseren Long-Range-Plan (LRP) und unsere langfristigen Geschäftsziele fungiert.
- Drive Scale & Operational Excellence: Überwachen Sie den täglichen Betrieb des Mitgliedschaftsprogramms und stellen Sie sicher, dass wir erstklassige Omnichannel-Erlebnisse bieten, die unserer Community und unserem Geschäft maximalen Nutzen bringen.
- Personalisierung & Kundenverständnis: Champion-Personalisierungsinitiativen über die gesamte Mitgliedschaft hinweg. Nutzen Sie Daten und Erkenntnisse, um ein tiefes, differenziertes Verständnis unserer Kunden zu fördern, so dass wir Interaktionen maßgeschneidert und ihre Bedürfnisse antizipieren können.
- Funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Arbeiten Sie als wichtiger Stakeholder des Digital Loyalty Stream eng zusammen, um die Erfahrungen zu identifizieren und zu liefern, die das Mitgliederprogramm kanalübergreifend zum Leben erwecken. Spearhead arbeitet funktionsübergreifend mit dem Rest des Unternehmens zusammen, um die Strategie umzusetzen und Ergebnisse zu erzielen und eng mit den Teams für Digital, Commercial, Product, Retail, Events und Marketing zusammenzuarbeiten.

Deine Geschichte

- Erfahrung: 7+ Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in der strategischen Planung, im Marketing oder in einem verwandten Bereich, mit einem nachgewiesenen Fokus auf kundenorientierte Strategien.
- Spezialisierung: 3+ Jahre engagierte Erfahrung Aufbau, Verwaltung oder Optimierung Loyalität oder Mitgliedschaft Programme auf globaler oder großer Ebene.
- Führung: Bewährte Teamführungs- und Change-Management-Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Teams zu inspirieren und die Ausrichtung auf eine gemeinsame Vision voranzutreiben.
- Kundenbesessen: Eine tiefe Leidenschaft für das Verständnis des Verbraucherverhaltens, mit einem starken Hintergrund in der Nutzung von Erkenntnissen, um hochgradig personalisierte Customer Journeys zu erstellen.
- Strategischer Denker: Fähigkeit, tägliche operative Initiativen mit langfristigen Geschäftsambitionen zu verbinden, insbesondere im Rahmen einer langfristigen Unternehmensplanung.

Treffen Sie das Team

Wir verwalten nicht nur eine Datenbank, wir bauen eine globale Bewegung auf. Das CRM- und Loyalty-Team befindet sich an der Schnittstelle von Daten, Kultur und Community und dient als Brücke zwischen den physischen Hubs von On und unserem digitalen Ökosystem.

Wir sind ein kollaboratives, kundenbesessenes Kraftpaket, das täglich mit Digital, Retail und Marketing zusammenarbeitet, um Casual Runner zu lebenslangen Fans zu machen. Wir leben von einer "Test-and-Learning" -Mentalität und behandeln unsere Ziele mit dem Geist einer leistungsstarken Sportmannschaft. Hier leiten Sie die Verantwortung und gestalten ein Premium-Erlebnis, das unsere globale Gemeinschaft dazu inspiriert, in Bewegung zu bleiben.

Was wir anbieten

On ist ein Ort, der sich um Wachstum und Fortschritt dreht. Wir bieten eine Umgebung, die den Menschen die Werkzeuge gibt, sich ganzheitlich zu entwickeln - aktiv zu bleiben, zu lernen, zu erforschen und zu innovieren. Unser unverwechselbarer Ansatz kombiniert eine unterstützende, teamorientierte Atmosphäre mit dem Zugang zu persönlicher Selbstfürsorge für körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden, so dass jede Person von ihrem Zweck geleitet wird.

On ist ein Equal Opportunity Arbeitgeber. Wir sind bestrebt, ein faires und integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Entscheidungen in Bezug auf Rekrutierung, Förderung und Bindung frei von Diskriminierung sind.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chef de la composition

Rapports à: Directeur de la CRM et de la fidélité

Vision

Chez On, nous croyons au pouvoir du mouvement et de la communauté; notre programme d'adhésion est le fil conjonctif sur nos points de contact commerciaux et de marque, nous permettant d'identifier et de récompenser nos clients les plus fidèles, de les inciter à bouger et de leur offrir le meilleur de On.

Le chef de l'adhésion jouera un rôle essentiel dans l'élargissement de notre programme d'adhésion afin de s'assurer qu'il continue d'appuyer notre stratégie opérationnelle globale et de stimuler l'impact à long terme. Favoriser la fidélité des clients est absolument crucial pour réaliser nos ambitions du Plan à long terme (PLT), ce qui rend ce rôle central dans notre croissance future.

Mission clé

Votre mission est de bâtir une communauté d'adhésion florissante qui stimule la valeur mutuelle pour nos clients les plus fidèles et notre marque, en offrant un programme d'adhésion omnicanal premium qui a l'objectif final d'augmenter la fréquence d'achat et CLV. Vous allez construire et à l'échelle une suite d'avantages enrichissants qui engage profondément notre communauté et conduit les objectifs commerciaux à long terme de l'entreprise.

Votre mission

- L'adhésion des champions à On: Servir de voix interne du membre et du porte-parole du programme d'adhésion, en veillant à ce que la fidélité de la clientèle demeure une priorité dans toutes les fonctions opérationnelles.
- Posséder la suite Avantages : Créer, gérer et piloter le calendrier annuel des activations et des avantages des membres, en veillant à ce qu'il y ait toujours des avantages pertinents et gratifiants qui correspondent vraiment à notre mission de marque et apportent de la valeur à nos membres.
- Leadership stratégique : Exécuter et itérer la stratégie globale d'adhésion en utilisant une approche d'essai et d'apprentissage pour s'assurer qu'elle joue un rôle clé dans notre Plan à long terme (PRT) et nos objectifs opérationnels à long terme.
- Échelle d'entraînement et excellence opérationnelle : Surveillez les opérations quotidiennes du programme d'adhésion, en veillant à offrir des expériences omnicanal premium qui apportent le maximum de valeur à notre collectivité et à nos entreprises.
- Personnalisation et compréhension des clients : Champions initiatives de personnalisation dans toute l'expérience des membres. Tirer parti des données et des idées pour susciter une compréhension profonde et nuancée de nos clients, nous permettant d'adapter les interactions et d'anticiper leurs besoins.
- Collaboration interfonctionnelle : En tant qu'intervenants clés du volet Loyauté numérique, collaborez étroitement pour identifier et transmettre les expériences qui font vivre le programme d'adhésion à travers les canaux. La collaboration interfonctionnelle Spearhead dans le reste de l'entreprise pour produire la stratégie et produire les résultats, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de Digital, Commercial, Product, Retail, Events et Marketing.

Votre histoire

- Expérience : plus de 7 ans d'expérience progressive dans la planification stratégique, le marketing ou un domaine connexe, en mettant l'accent sur les stratégies axées sur le client.
- Spécialisation : 3 ans et plus d'expérience dédiée à la construction, à la gestion ou à l'optimisation de programmes de fidélité ou d'adhésion à un niveau mondial ou à grande échelle.
- Leadership : Compétences éprouvées en leadership d'équipe et en gestion du changement, avec la capacité d'inspirer des équipes interfonctionnelles et d'orienter l'alignement vers une vision partagée.
- Customer-Obsessed: Profondément passionné par la compréhension du comportement des consommateurs, avec une solide expérience dans l'exploitation des idées pour créer des voyages clients hautement personnalisés.
- Penseur stratégique : Capacité de relier les initiatives opérationnelles quotidiennes aux ambitions opérationnelles à long terme, en particulier dans le contexte de la planification ministérielle à long terme.

Rencontrez l'équipe

Nous ne gérons pas seulement une base de données, nous construisons un mouvement mondial. L'équipe CRM et Loyalty se trouve à l'intersection des données, de la culture et de la communauté, servant de pont entre les centres de course physique d'On.

Nous sommes une centrale collaborative, obsédée par le client, en partenariat quotidien avec Digital, Retail et Marketing pour transformer les coureurs occasionnels en fans à vie. Nous prospérons dans une mentalité de « test-and-learn » en traitant nos objectifs avec l'esprit d'une équipe sportive hautement performante. Ici, vous dirigerez la charge, façonnant une expérience premium qui inspire notre communauté mondiale à continuer de bouger.

Ce que nous offrons

Sur est un endroit qui est centré sur la croissance et le progrès. Nous offrons un environnement conçu pour donner aux gens les outils pour se développer de manière holistique – rester actifs, apprendre, explorer et innover. Notre approche distinctive combine une atmosphère de soutien et d'équipe, avec l'accès à des soins personnels pour le bien-être physique et mental, de sorte que chaque personne est dirigée par but.

Il y a un employeur de l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes déterminés à créer un milieu de travail équitable et inclusif, où toutes les décisions liées au recrutement, à l'avancement et au maintien en poste sont exemptes de discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve

Che tu stia cercando di iniziare la tua carriera o di acquisire la prima esperienza pratica in un nuovo campo, uno stage a On ti offre un'esperienza di crescita unica, la possibilità di fare un impatto dal primo giorno e contribuire al viaggio di crescita On.s. Siamo alla ricerca di idee fresche, menti curiose e persone appassionate pronte a fare la differenza. I nostri stage generalmente durano sei mesi e sarete completamente incorporati in una squadra.

- Data di inizio: 1 Marzo 2026 - Durata: Sei mesi - Prerequisito: Interesse per l'area relativa allo stage, passione per On, diritto di lavorare in UE / Svizzera - Nota: Questo è uno stage pagato - Se non si soddisfa i criteri di cui sopra, purtroppo, non possiamo andare avanti con la vostra domanda. Si prega di essere sinceri nelle vostre risposte, il reclutatore che rivede la vostra domanda apprezzerà la vostra onestà.

Curioso della vita come stagista a On? Vi consigliamo di guardare la registrazione del nostro precedente livestream ( https://www.careerfairy.io/company/On_AG/livestream/eCaoLI8t0mYLqzRYM1eq) per ascoltare ex stagisti condividere la loro esperienza di stage, ottenere un insider.s guardare diversi dipartimenti e raccogliere alcuni suggerimenti e trucchi dai nostri reclutatori per aiutarvi ad affrontare il processo di applicazione.

La tua squadra

Siamo un piccolo team di finanza orientato all'azione con grandi responsabilità e impatto in tutta l'organizzazione. Evolviamo le migliori pratiche pensando al futuro, lavorando in modo trasversale e sfruttando le più recenti tecnologie per sostenere l'integrità, l'accuratezza e la trasparenza dei rapporti finanziari pubblicati esternamente da On.s. Il team di Group Reporting è responsabile per la rendicontazione finanziaria esterna di On.s, i bilanci consolidati, le politiche contabili e le questioni tecniche di contabilità, in conformità con le normative.

La tua missione

• Supporto con la preparazione di relazioni finanziarie trimestrali, semestrali e annuali archiviate presso la Commissione degli strumenti finanziari e di cambio (U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission) e pubblicate esternamente, in conformità con gli IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) e i regolamenti SEC. Aiuterai a garantire che le nostre informazioni finanziarie pubblicate esternamente siano accurate e conformi.

• Collaborare con Contabilità, Finanza, Legale, Controllo, Tesoro, Investor Relations e altri team per raccogliere dati critici e approfondimenti qualitativi per il nostro reporting.

• Assistenza nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di miglioramenti dei processi sfruttando l'AI e la tecnologia per semplificare e automatizzare i processi di reporting di gruppo.

• Assistenza con analisi ad hoc, progetti interfunzionali, attività di consolidamento mensile, politiche contabili e note tecniche di contabilità.

La tua storia

• Attualmente perseguendo un Bachelor.s o Master.s laurea in Contabilità, Finanza, o un campo correlato.

• Comprensione di base della contabilità (IFRS considerato a plus)

• Curioso di conoscere meglio il ruolo di AI e l'automazione in un dipartimento di finanza

• Forte capacità analitiche e di risoluzione dei problemi

• Altamente auto-motivato individuo con una mentalità positiva e. can-do.

• Eccellente attenzione ai dettagli, organizzazione e follow-through.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese
descriptionByLocale.en:
In short

Whether you’re looking to jump start your career or gain first hands-on experience in a new field, an internship at On offers you a unique growth experience, the chance to make an impact from day one and contribute to On’s growth journey. We are looking for fresh ideas, curious minds and passionate individuals ready to make a difference. Our internships generally last six months and you will be fully embedded in a team.

- Start date: March 1st 2026
- Duration: Six months
- Prerequisite: Interest in area relevant to the internship, passion for On, right to work in EU / Switzerland
- Note: This is a paid internship
- If you don't meet the criteria above, unfortunately, we cannot move forward with your application. Please be truthful in your answers, the recruiter reviewing your application will appreciate your honesty.

Curious about life as an intern at On? We recommend watching the recording of our previous livestream ( https://www.careerfairy.io/company/On_AG/livestream/eCaoLI8t0mYLqzRYM1eq ) to hear former interns share their internship experience, get an insider’s look at different departments and pick up some tips and tricks from our recruiters to help you ace the application process.

Your team

We are a small, action-oriented Finance team with big responsibilities and impact across the organization. We evolve best practices by being forward-thinking, working cross-functionally, and leveraging the latest technology to uphold the integrity, accuracy, and transparency of On’s externally published financial reports. The Group Reporting team is responsible for On’s external financial reporting, consolidated financial statements, accounting policies, and technical accounting matters, in compliance with regulations.

Your mission

• Support with the preparation of quarterly, semi-annual, and annual financial reports filed with the SEC (U.S Securities and Exchange Commission) and published externally, in accordance with IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards) and SEC regulations. You will help ensure our externally published financial information is accurate and in compliance.

• Partner and collaborate with Accounting, Finance, Legal, Controlling, Treasury, Investor Relations and other teams to gather critical data and qualitative insights for our reporting.

• Assist in developing and implementing process improvements by leveraging AI and technology to streamline and automate group reporting processes.

• Assist with ad-hoc analysis, cross-functional projects, monthly consolidation tasks, accounting policies, and technical accounting memos.

Your story

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Basic understanding of accounting (IFRS considered a plus)

• Curious to learn more about the role of AI and automation in a Finance department

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Highly self-motivated individual with a positive and “can-do” mindset.

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Ihr Team

Ihre Mission

• Partner und Kooperation mit Accounting, Finance, Legal, Controlling, Treasury, Investor Relations und anderen Teams, um kritische Daten und qualitative Erkenntnisse für unsere Berichterstattung zu sammeln.

• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Prozessverbesserungen durch die Nutzung von KI und Technologie zur Optimierung und Automatisierung von Gruppenberichterstattungsprozessen.

• Unterstützung bei der Ad-hoc-Analyse, funktionsübergreifenden Projekten, monatlichen Konsolidierungsaufgaben, Rechnungslegungsrichtlinien und technischen Rechnungslegungs-Memoranden.

Ihre Geschichte

• Derzeit verfolgt einen Bachelor, Master, Abschluss in Buchhaltung, Finanzen oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Grundlegendes Verständnis der Rechnungslegung (IFRS als Plus)

• Neugierig, mehr über die Rolle von KI und Automatisierung in einer Finanzabteilung zu erfahren

Votre équipe

Nous sommes une petite équipe de finance orientée vers l'action qui a de grandes responsabilités et un impact dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Nous élaborons les meilleures pratiques en étant prospectifs, en travaillant de façon interfonctionnelle et en tirant parti des dernières technologies pour maintenir l'intégrité, l'exactitude et la transparence des rapports financiers publiés à l'extérieur. L'équipe de rapports de groupe est responsable de l'information financière externe, des états financiers consolidés, des politiques comptables et des questions techniques de comptabilité, conformément aux règlements.

Votre mission

• Soutien à la préparation de rapports financiers trimestriels, semestriels et annuels déposés auprès du SEC (Commission des valeurs mobilières et des bourses des États-Unis) et publiés à l'extérieur, conformément aux normes IFRS (normes internationales d'information financière) et aux règlements SEC. Vous contribuerez à garantir que nos informations financières publiées à l'extérieur sont exactes et conformes.

• Partenaire et collabore avec des équipes de comptabilité, de finances, de droit, de contrôle, de trésorerie, de relations avec les investisseurs et d'autres pour recueillir des données critiques et des informations qualitatives pour nos rapports.

• Aider à élaborer et à mettre en oeuvre des améliorations des processus en tirant parti de l'IA et de la technologie pour rationaliser et automatiser les processus de rapports de groupe.

• Aider à l'analyse ad hoc, aux projets transfonctionnels, aux tâches mensuelles de consolidation, aux conventions comptables et aux notes techniques comptables.

Votre histoire

• Actuellement, il est titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en comptabilité, en finances ou dans un domaine connexe.

• Compréhension de base de la comptabilité (IFRS considéré comme un plus)

• Curieusement, vous pouvez en apprendre davantage sur le rôle de l'IA et de l'automatisation dans un département des Finances

• Fortes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes

• Personne hautement automotivée avec un état d'esprit positif et, peut-être.

• Une excellente attention aux détails, à l'organisation et au suivi.

• Fortes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

In breve:

La missione di On è diventare il marchio leader di abbigliamento sportivo di punta, radicato nel design, nelle prestazioni e nella sostenibilità.Per questo impegno, siamo alla ricerca di uno specialista dedicato dei dati di sostenibilità a Zurigo che sosterrà i nostri sforzi di dati per le nostre ambizioni e requisiti di sostenibilità.Contribuendo alla nostra contabilità annuale dei GHG, sarete responsabili della raccolta, convalida e calcolo dei dati di campo 1-3 e della costruzione di flussi di dati end-to-end per trasformare i dati grezzi in metriche attuabili.

Leveraging il tuo record di carbon accounting e ingegneria dei dati, eseguirai flussi di lavoro per la divulgazione dei dati e requisiti normativi. Collaborerai con gli stakeholder Tech e business per semplificare i flussi di lavoro e i sistemi, supportando i team di Product Sustainability, Traceability e Responsible Manufacturing con esigenze di dati. Se sei esperto di dati con un record di track record nella contabilità GHG e stai cercando di avere un impatto in un marchio di abbigliamento sportivo in crescita, questo ruolo è per te!

La tua missione

- Raccogliere, convalidare e calcolare i dati di campo 1-3 e gestire i rapporti con i proprietari dei dati. - Modelli e mappa dei flussi di dati di sostenibilità end-to-end dai sistemi di origine agli strumenti di reporting, trasformando i dati grezzi in metriche attuabili. - Identificare le opportunità di razionalizzare i flussi di lavoro e i sistemi in collaborazione con i team Tech. - Eseguire flussi di lavoro dati per la divulgazione della sostenibilità e requisiti normativi (ad esempio CSRD). - Supportare i team di produzione di prodotti di sostenibilità, tracciabilità e responsabilità con attività di raccolta dati, visualizzazione e ingegneria.

La tua storia

- Laurea in Scienze dei Dati, Ingegneria Ambientale, Sostenibilità o un campo correlato. - Min. 1 anno di esperienza in dati di sostenibilità con un track record in contabilità del carbonio, esperto in Protocollo GHG. - Capacità di codificare in Python per l'elaborazione dei dati e l'automazione dei compiti. - Esperienza con architetture BigQuery o data warehouse simili, compresa la scrittura e l'ottimizzazione delle query. - Proficienza negli strumenti di gestione dei dati (Excel, Google Sheets). - Forte comprensione delle metriche di sostenibilità, standard di reporting (come SBTi), e regolamenti globali.

- Alta attenzione ai dettagli con la capacità di strutturare e convalidare dati complessi. - Capacità di collaborare con team tecnici e stakeholder aziendali. - Fluenza in inglese. - Passione per la sostenibilità.

Incontra la squadra

Siamo un piccolo team con grandi responsabilità. Progettiamo e implementiamo la strategia di sostenibilità attraverso On e aiutiamo a modellare il futuro dell'organizzazione. Siamo ricercatori, creiamo strategie e implementare progetti e innoviamo prodotti e processi attraverso la lente della sostenibilità. Siamo l'hub strategico, fissando la direzione e il ritmo per l'impatto aziendale definendo priorità, obiettivi e politiche. Agiamo come educatori e attivatori interni, fornendo strumenti e formazione, e poi a 36 per il nostro progresso attraverso una comunicazione chiara internamente ed esterna.

Cosa offriamo

- Un ambiente dinamico classificato come "società sportiva in rapida crescita" dove il vostro lavoro influisce direttamente sulla nostra impronta globale. - Una cultura che promuove l'eccellenza e il potenziale. - Questo ruolo offre una profonda esposizione alla pianificazione strategica e alla crescita della conoscenza tecnica. - L'opportunità di costruire qualcosa di incredibile con una comunità globale collaborativa e ad alta energia dove si può veramente prosperare.

Se siete spinti a portare al livello successivo, curiosi circa l'opportunità e vogliono essere parte del nostro team in crescita inviaci la tua domanda, e unirsi all'ONIverse!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

In Short:

On's mission is to become the leading premium sportswear brand rooted in design, performance and sustainability. To drive this commitment, we are looking for a dedicated Sustainability Data Specialist in Zurich who will support our data efforts for our sustainability ambitions and requirements. Contributing to our annual GHG accounting, you will be responsible for collecting, validating, and calculating Scope 1-3 data, and building end-to-end data flows to transform raw source data into actionable metrics. Leveraging your track record in carbon accounting and data engineering, you will execute data workstreams for sustainability disclosure and regulatory requirements. You will collaborate with Tech and business stakeholders to streamline data workflows and systems, while supporting the Product Sustainability, Traceability, and Responsible Manufacturing teams with data needs. If you are data-savvy with a track record in GHG accounting and are looking to make an impact in a growing sportswear brand, this role is for you!

Your Mission

- Collect, validate, and calculate Scope 1-3 data and manage relationships with data owners.
- Model and map end-to-end sustainability data flows from source systems to reporting tools, transforming raw data into actionable metrics.
- Identify opportunities to streamline data workflows and systems in collaboration with Tech teams.
- Execute data workstreams for sustainability disclosure and regulatory requirements (e.g., CSRD).
- Support Product Sustainability, Traceability and Responsible Manufacturing teams with data collection, visualization, and engineering tasks.

Your Story

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, or a related field.
- Min. 1 year of experience in sustainability data with a track record in carbon accounting, expert in GHG Protocol.
- Ability to code in Python for data processing and automation of tasks.
- Experience with BigQuery or similar data warehouse architectures, including writing and optimizing queries.
- Proficiency in data management tools (Excel, Google Sheets).
- Strong understanding of sustainability metrics, reporting standards (such as SBTi), and global regulations.
- High attention to detail with the ability to structure and validate complex data.
- Ability to collaborate with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
- Fluency in English.
- Passion for sustainability.

Meet The Team

We are a small team with big responsibilities. We design and implement the sustainability strategy across On and help shape the future of the organization. We do research, create strategies and implement projects and innovate products and processes through the lens of sustainability. We are the strategic hub, setting the direction and pace for corporate impact by defining priorities, targets, and policies. We act as internal educators and enablers, providing tools and training, and then amplify our progress through clear communication internally and externally.

What We Offer

- A dynamic environment ranked as a "fastest-growing sports company" where your work directly impacts our global footprint.
- A culture that fosters excellence and potential.
- This role offers deep exposure to strategic planning and technical knowledge growth.
- The chance to build something incredible with a collaborative, high-energy global community where you can truly thrive.

If you are driven to bring On to the next level, curious about the opportunity and want to be part of our growing team send us your application, and join the ONiverse!

Wenn Sie dazu getrieben werden, auf die nächste Ebene zu kommen, neugierig auf die Gelegenheit und wollen Teil unseres wachsenden Teams sein senden Sie uns Ihre Bewerbung, und kommen Sie in die ONIverse!

Désignation des marchandises

Pour mener à bien cet engagement, nous recherchons un spécialiste des données sur la durabilité à Zurich qui soutiendra nos efforts de données pour nos ambitions et nos exigences en matière de durabilité. En confrontant à notre comptabilité annuelle des GES, vous serez responsable de la collecte, de la validation et du calcul des données de la portée 1-3 et de la construction de flux de données de bout en bout pour transformer les données brutes en mesures actionnables.

Vous travaillerez avec les techniciens et les intervenants commerciaux pour rationaliser les flux de données et les systèmes tout en soutenant les équipes de durabilité des produits, de traçabilité et de fabrication responsable qui ont besoin de données. Si vous êtes un expert en comptabilité des GES et que vous cherchez à faire un impact dans une marque de sportwear en croissance, ce rôle est pour vous!

Votre mission

- Collecter, valider et calculer les données de portée 1-3 et gérer les relations avec les propriétaires de données. - Modéliser et cartographier les flux de données de bout en bout sur la durabilité des systèmes sources aux outils de déclaration, transformer les données brutes en mesures exploitables. - Identifier les possibilités de rationaliser les flux de travail et les systèmes de données en collaboration avec les équipes techniques. - Exécuter les flux de données pour la divulgation de la durabilité et les exigences réglementaires (p. ex., CSRD). - Soutenir les équipes de durabilité des produits, de traçabilité et de fabrication responsable avec des tâches de collecte de données, de visualisation et d'ingénierie.

Votre histoire

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences des données, génie environnemental, durabilité ou un domaine connexe. - Expérience de 1 an d'expérience en données de durabilité avec un dossier de comptabilisation du carbone, expert en protocole de GES. - Capacité de coder en Python pour le traitement des données et l'automatisation des tâches. - Expérience avec BigQuery ou des architectures similaires de stockage de données, y compris l'écriture et l'optimisation des requêtes. - Compétence en outils de gestion des données (Excel, Google Sheets). - Connaissance approfondie des paramètres de durabilité, des normes de rapport (comme SBti) et des règlements mondiaux.

- Une grande attention aux détails avec la capacité de structurer et de valider des données complexes. - Capacité de collaborer avec les équipes techniques et les intervenants commerciaux. - Fluence en anglais. - Passion de durabilité.

Rencontrez l'équipe

Nous sommes une petite équipe qui a de grandes responsabilités. Nous concevons et mettons en œuvre la stratégie de durabilité dans l'ensemble de l'organisation et nous aidons à façonner l'avenir de l'organisation. Nous faisons de la recherche, créons des stratégies et implémentons des projets et innovons des produits et des processus à travers l'objectif de durabilité. Nous sommes le centre stratégique, nous définissons l'orientation et le rythme de l'impact organisationnel en définissant les priorités, les cibles et les politiques.

Ce que nous offrons

- Un environnement dynamique classé comme une « entreprise sportive en pleine croissance » où votre travail a une incidence directe sur notre empreinte mondiale. - Une culture qui favorise l'excellence et le potentiel. - Ce rôle offre une exposition profonde à la planification stratégique et à la croissance des connaissances techniques. - La chance de construire quelque chose d'incroyable avec une communauté mondiale collaborative et à haute énergie où vous pouvez vraiment prospérer.

Si vous êtes poussé à porter le niveau Au prochain, curieux de l'opportunité et voulez faire partie de notre équipe en pleine croissance envoyez-nous votre candidature, et rejoignez l'ONiverse!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Lead Technical Product Manager, Operations AI & Data The Team The Product Management Technology team is the digital backbone of On's product creation engine. We are a team of strategic product leaders who partner with core business functions—from R&D and Design to Sourcing and Supply Chain—to build the platforms and systems that power On's growth. Our mission is to create a seamless, intelligent, and efficient digital ecosystem that enables our teams to design and deliver the next generation of revolutionary products. We are internal entrepreneurs, deeply embedded in the business, who identify complex challenges and build elegant, scalable solutions. As a member of our team, you will have a unique opportunity to drive significant transformation and make a tangible impact on the future of one of the world's most exciting brands. The Role At On, our supply chain is the backbone of our global operation. We are looking for a visionary Lead Technical Product Manager to spearhead the next evolution of our supply chain by harnessing the power of Artificial Intelligence and data. In this leadership role, you will be the bridge between our complex operational challenges and cutting-edge data solutions. You will be responsible for identifying high-impact opportunities where data, AI and automation can revolutionize our planning, logistics, and decision-making processes. Your expertise will be in understanding the business, the data, and the possibilities of AI to define a compelling product vision and guide our AI, data and engineering teams to build solutions that deliver immense value. As a Lead, you will also play a key role in mentoring other product managers and shaping the product culture within the team. What You'll Do
• Own the Data & AI Product Vision: Develop and champion a clear product strategy and roadmap for Data & AI-driven initiatives within the supply chain domain.
• Identify Opportunities: Collaborate closely and build relationships with supply chain stakeholders to deeply understand their processes, data challenges, and automation pain points.
• Translate Problems into Solutions: Convert ambiguous business problems into well-defined product requirements, user stories, and specifications for our data science and engineering teams to drive measurable value.
• Prioritize for Impact: Create and manage a data-driven product backlog, prioritizing features and initiatives that deliver the highest value to the business.
• Define Success: Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness and impact of your AI/data products, in partnership with analytics.
• Bridge the Gap: Serve as the primary liaison between business leaders, supply chain operators, data scientists, and engineers, ensuring alignment and clear communication across all teams. What You'll Bring
• Leadership Experience: Proven experience as a Technical Product Manager, with a demonstrated history of leading significant products or initiatives from concept to launch.
• Supply Chain Acumen: Strong experience with supply chain data and a solid understanding of core supply chain principles (e.g., demand forecasting, inventory management, logistics).
• AI/Data Fluency: You have a basic familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts and, most importantly, a gift for translating business needs into data-driven solutions. You don't need to be an AI expert, but you must be adept at partnering with engineers and data scientists who are.
• Analytical mindset: You are able to creatively identify the right success metrics and analyses that will provide key insight into product functionality.
• Technical Aptitude: You are comfortable in a technical environment and capable of holding your own in discussions about data models, APIs, and system architecture.
• Strategic Problem-Solver: You excel at breaking down large, complex problems into actionable steps and have a strategic mindset to see the bigger picture.
• Exceptional Communication: You have an outstanding ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Leadership Experience: Proven experience as a Technical Product Manager, with a demonstrated history of leading significant products or initiatives from concept to launch.
• Supply Chain Acumen: Strong experience with supply chain data and a solid understanding of core supply chain principles (e.g., demand forecasting, inventory management, logistics).
• AI/Data Fluency: You have a basic familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts and, most importantly, a gift for translating business needs into data-driven solutions. You don't need to be an AI expert, but you must be adept at partnering with engineers and data scientists who are.
• Analytical mindset: You are able to creatively identify the right success metrics and analyses that will provide key insight into product functionality.
• Technical Aptitude: You are comfortable in a technical environment and capable of holding your own in discussions about data models, APIs, and system architecture.
• Strategic Problem-Solver: You excel at breaking down large, complex problems into actionable steps and have a strategic mindset to see the bigger picture.
• Exceptional Communication: You have an outstanding ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In short As a Junior Apparel Developer at On, you will play an active role in bringing high-performance apparel to life, contributing to innovative products that meet the demands of elite athletes and the next generation of performance consumers. You’ll support the end-to-end development process across seasonal collections and special projects, collaborating closely with Design, Materials, Innovation, and Sourcing teams. You will join a small, agile development team focused on delivering world-class performance apparel. Working closely alongside a Senior Apparel Developer and Lead Developer, you will receive direct mentorship and hands-on guidance while taking responsibility for specific product areas. This provides a unique opportunity to accelerate your technical expertise, build your product knowledge, and contribute meaningfully to some of On's most innovative performance projects. With a sharp eye for detail, a solid foundational knowledge of garment construction, and a solutions-driven mindset, you’ll help ensure every product meets On’s high standards for performance, quality, fit, durability, and innovation. This role requires an effective communicator who is eager to learn, capable of managing assigned projects efficiently, and deeply passionate about developing technically advanced performance apparel. Your Mission:
• Support the development of a seasonal performance apparel collection, helping to create innovative products that meet the needs of athletes and performance consumers while reflecting On’s performance DNA.
• Assist and manage assigned stages of product development from concept through commercialization, ensuring products deliver against performance, innovation, quality, and athlete expectations under the guidance of senior team members.
• Collaborate with Design to create accurate, production-ready Tech Packs and ensure supplier instructions are clear, detailed, and aligned.
• Apply foundational construction techniques and seek technical solutions that meet design intent, performance requirements, fit standards, cost targets, and sustainability goals.
• Help execute fit, wear testing, and quality standards across assigned product ranges, ensuring products perform reliably under intended use conditions.
• Maintain product development documentation using Adobe Illustrator and PLM tools to manage detailed specifications, construction artwork, and material selections.
• Actively participate in fit sessions, bringing a strong standard of execution, technical curiosity, and growing competitor awareness.
• Partner with the Materials Developer to select and source materials that enhance performance, comfort, durability, and athlete experience.
• Maintain positive, collaborative relationships with key suppliers to ensure product quality, innovation, and production readiness.
• Make informed decisions within your assigned project scope, balancing design intent and technical feasibility while escalating complex issues appropriately.
• Manage assigned tasks concurrently, prioritizing effectively to deliver on timelines, quality, and cost goals with guidance from senior developers.
• Contribute to solving technical challenges related to construction, materials, fit, or production, showing a proactive attitude toward continuous process improvement.
• Develop foundational expertise in specialized performance categories, eagerly learning from senior colleagues to grow your technical knowledge.
• Collaborate effectively across functions including Design, Materials, Sourcing, Engineering, Innovation, Athlete Management, and external partners to support alignment from concept to production.
• Provide clear, timely product input and feedback to internal teams and suppliers, maintaining open and collaborative communication.
• Embrace a growth mindset by actively seeking feedback, reflecting on product outcomes, and fostering a collaborative, solution-focused team culture.
• Learn and apply costing principles, contributing to cost engineering efforts to meet commercial targets without compromising product performance or design intent. Your Story:
• Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Design, Apparel Engineering, Sportswear Development, or a related technical field.
• 2+ years of experience in apparel development, ideally with an exposure to performance apparel, technical sportswear, or athlete-focused product.
• Strong interest in athlete needs and a growing ability to help translate performance requirements into commercially viable products.
• Good foundational knowledge of garment construction, basic pattern understanding, materials, and fit.
• Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with a hands-on approach and openness to learning unconventional thinking.
• Proficient in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, PLM systems, and Microsoft Office tools.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and ambitious product innovation goals.
• Willingness to travel regularly between HQ and global development and manufacturing partners as needed.
• Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines.
• Excited to work within a small, highly collaborative team environment where learning, growth, and continuous development are prioritized.
• Highly motivated to learn from experienced technical leaders while progressively taking on more independent responsibility for complex product categories.

titleByLocale.en: Senior Lead - Product Finance (9-month maternity cover)
